description: Manual review of ReasonIF instruction-following passes whose reasoning could be empty or incoherent. Candidates: every pass of a language constraint whose target language is not English, and every pass whose reasoning has fewer than 20 words (CJK characters counted as words). Each candidate was read; only passes judged 'no_reasoning' (the reasoning is a heading, a boilerplate sentence or unrelated text) or 'incoherent' (word salad) are listed in 'excluded'. All other candidates were kept, including short but genuine explanations (e.g. 18-word answers to word-limit items) and traces with some garbled fragments. Grader output is unchanged; this file only drives the sensitivity rows in table30.
